# Christopher Mejo, Ph.D.
> AI Research Scientist specializing in Large Language Model (LLM) Systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic Reasoning, and Reinforcement Learning for Sequential Decision-Making.

Christopher Mejo is an AI Research Scientist, Systems Architect, and Technical Advisor with 15+ years taking machine learning systems from theoretical research prototypes to high-throughput production. He holds a Ph.D. in Physics from Harvard University (quantum information and complexity theory, completed at age 21) and completed postdoctoral training at MIT under Dr. Scott Aaronson. He holds an active Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance.

## Key Information

## Core Accomplishments & Statistics
- Solo-architected AI Scholar (github.com/cmejo/AI_Scholar), an open-source hybrid RAG platform indexing 15M+ research papers (Google Summer of Code Fellow 2024 & 2025 with R Foundation).
- Delivered 6.2 Sharpe ratio (Sortino 8.4, max drawdown <1.9%) over 24-month continuous live trading window executing billions in volume at Braverock LLC.
- Built transformer market-prediction pipelines handling 1B+ quote data points per day at microsecond latency.
- Directed distributed pretraining & fine-tuning of 7B-14B parameter foundation models with DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 and custom CUDA memory-mapped tokenizers (-38% wall-clock step latency).
- Built CushionNLP (BERT transformer) driving 30% increase in bank-fee negotiation success and $2M+ annual savings.
- Federated medical computer vision (EfficientNet-B7) achieving 0.972 ROC-AUC under differential privacy (ε=1.2, δ=10^-5) across 4 healthcare institutions.
- Active Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance.
